content.value_statement: Email teams need persuasive copy without unsupported claims or mismatched landing pages. This skill creates a complete email unit with clear review flags.
actual_capabilities: Drafts three to five labeled subject-line variants and one matched preheader.
Writes structured email body copy with one primary call to action.
Creates a plain-text alternate for accessibility and deliverability.
Supports promotional, cold-outbound, and newsletter writing modes.
Maps email claims and calls to action against destination-page content.
Flags unsupported claims with a visible needs-source marker.
limitations: It does not score, rank, or predict subject-line performance.
It does not calculate email quality scores or run deliverability tests.
It does not design multi-email sequences or experimentation plans.
It cannot verify message matching when no destination content is available.

use_cases.title: Launch a promotional email
use_cases.description: Create offer-led copy with honest urgency, verified terms, one purchase action, and matching landing-page language.

use_cases.title: Draft personalized outreach
use_cases.description: Write a concise cold email using a verifiable personalization signal, one value point, and a low-pressure reply request.

use_cases.title: Prepare a newsletter edition
use_cases.description: Build value-led editorial copy with a clear primary action and an explicitly disclosed sponsor section.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a promotional email
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a promotional email for [offer] aimed at [audience]. Use [destination URL], [brand voice], and verified terms: [terms].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a complete promotional email.

prompt_templates.title: Create cold outreach
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a cold email to [persona] about [offer]. Personalize with [verified signal] and ask for [reply action].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for relevance-based B2B outreach.

prompt_templates.title: Revise existing creative
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise this email: [copy]. Keep [winning elements], replace [weak elements], and match every claim to [destination URL].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced revision using existing campaign evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Build a claim-traced newsletter
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a newsletter about [topic] for [audience]. Include [sections], disclose [sponsor], flag unsupported claims, and provide a message-match map.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced editorial workflow with sponsorship and claim controls.

output_examples.input: Write cold outreach to operations leaders using a verified manual-reporting signal.
output_examples.output:
Subject: Still building weekly reports by hand?

Hi [First name], I noticed your team is hiring for reporting operations. Our workflow reduces repetitive report preparation [needs source]. Would a short comparison be useful?

CTA: Reply for the comparison

Claim note: The efficiency claim requires an approved source before sending.

best_practices: Provide the audience, mode, offer, destination, brand voice, and approved claim wording.
Verify every price, deadline, statistic, guarantee, and testimonial before sending.
Review the plain-text version and landing-page message match with the final creative.
anti_patterns: Do not request fabricated urgency, familiarity, testimonials, or performance claims.
Do not combine several competing primary calls to action in one email.
Do not treat generated copy as approved for sending without compliance and suppression checks.

faq.question: Does this skill send email campaigns?
faq.answer: No. It drafts creative and may save an approved artifact, but sending requires separate authorization and platform controls.

faq.question: Can it rank the subject-line variants?
faq.answer: No. It creates labeled variants but does not predict, score, or rank their performance.

faq.question: Which email types does it support?
faq.answer: It supports promotional and lifecycle email, B2B cold outreach, and newsletter creative.

faq.question: What happens when a claim lacks evidence?
faq.answer: The claim remains visibly marked as needing a source and blocks ready-to-send status.

faq.question: Is a destination page required?
faq.answer: A destination is required for click-focused email because the skill checks whether the page delivers the email promise.

faq.question: Does it create plain-text email?
faq.answer: Yes. Each completed creative includes a readable plain-text alternate with the same message and primary action.
